entries.title: Hosea 8:1
segments: Put a trumpet to your mouth. [He comes] like an eagle against the house of the LORD, because they have broken My covenant and have sinned against My law.

entries.title: Hosea 8:2
segments: Israel shall cry to Me, My God, we know You.

entries.title: Hosea 8:3
segments: Israel has thrown off good; the enemy shall pursue him.

entries.title: Hosea 8:4
segments: They have set up kings, but not by Me; they have made rulers, and I knew it not. They have made themselves idols [with] their silver and their gold, so that they may be cut off.

entries.title: Hosea 8:5
segments: Your calf, O Samaria, has cast [you] off. My anger is kindled against them. Until when will they not attain purity?

entries.title: Hosea 8:6
segments: For from Israel it [came] also. The craftsman made it, but [it is] not God. For the calf of Samaria shall be splinters.

entries.title: Hosea 8:7
segments: For they sow the wind, and they reap the whirlwind. It has no stalk; the bud shall yield no meal; if it does yield, strangers shall swallow it up.

entries.title: Hosea 8:8
segments: Israel is swallowed up; now they shall be among the nations as a vessel in which there is no pleasure.

entries.title: Hosea 8:9
segments: For they have gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself. Ephraim has hired lovers.

entries.title: Hosea 8:10
segments: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now I will gather them. And they began to be few, from the burden of the king of rulers.

entries.title: Hosea 8:11
segments: Because Ephraim has made many altars to sin, altars shall be to him to sin.

entries.title: Hosea 8:12
segments: I have written to him the great things of My law, but they were counted as a strange thing.

entries.title: Hosea 8:13
segments: They sacrifice flesh [for] the sacrifices of My offerings, and eat it; but the LORD does not receive them. Now He will remember their iniquity and punish their sins. They shall return [to] Egypt.

entries.title: Hosea 8:14
segments: For Israel has forgotten his Maker, and builds temples. And Judah has multiplied cities. But I will send a fire on his cities, and it shall burn up her palaces.
